section.title: Warm Up Activity
section.para: A mechanical device is used to launch a potato vertically into the air. The potato is launched from a platform 20 feet above the ground, with an initial vertical velocity of 92 feet per second.
The function \(h(t) = -16t^2 + 92t + 20\) models the height of the potato over the ground, in feet, \(t\) seconds after launch.
Here is the graph representing the function.
For each question, explain your reasoning.

div.para:
The height of the potato 1 second after launch will be 96 feet.
Substituting 1 second into the function \(h(t)\) yields:

list.item: What is the height of the potato 1 second after launch?
